computational_cost.timing_scope: per-image preprocessing and synchronized warm-model inference; one-time model loading is excluded

image_level_safety.aggregation: maximum detection uncertainty; images without operational detections receive uncertainty 1.0

primary_inference.success_rule: The primary all_internal fusion must improve both AUROC and AURC over confidence with one-sided sequence-clustered bootstrap tests after Holm correction, while its Brier score is non-inferior within an absolute margin of 0.02. Diagnostic or robustness subsets cannot satisfy this rule.
